2026-07-28 11:39:08.658817 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-28 11:39:08.658823 | controller |
2026-07-28 11:39:08.658827 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-28 11:39:08.658830 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-28 11:39:08.658840 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
